summary: GraalVM native image applications fail to connect to Temporal Server in Kubernetes with DEADLINE_EXCEEDED errors after pod rescheduling or node restarts, though the same application works fine on JVM and in Docker outside Kubernetes.
userImpact: Applications using GraalVM native images in Kubernetes experience 10-30 minute unavailability when pods are rescheduled or nodes are restarted, breaking production deployments.
rootCause: GraalVM native image runtime issue with DNS resolution or gRPC channel reuse in Kubernetes environment
keyQuote: Application fails to start for 10–30 minutes with io.grpc.StatusRuntimeException: DEADLINE_EXCEEDED while Temporal cluster is healthy
